data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, even if others choose 10—not an all-or-nothing deal. Each switch from 10 adds $8,000 if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k; stock left=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Even all 18 leaves 50, but recovery to 500 isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each of you: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others?
